# Router Park

> > Router Park provides free API gateways and comprehensive guides for accessing OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLM services, with specialized resources for Chinese developers.

Router Park offers free API relay services for GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude models with OpenAI-compatible interfaces. The platform provides multilingual documentation and extensive guides covering API access, payment methods, pricing optimization, and subscription strategies for AI services in restricted regions.
